## GRLS deprivation linkage

Further information on MDI: <https://www.census.gov/topics/income-poverty/poverty/about/related-sites/rates.html>

MDI is the US equivalent of the UK Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD). This analysis uses the most recent values available at the time of the original work: county-level 2019 MDI.

Veterinary-clinic and owner home ZIP codes are first linked to Federal Information Processing System (FIPS) county codes, then linked to county-level MDI. The ZIP-to-FIPS data come from <https://simplemaps.com/data/us-zips>.

This workflow links both veterinary-clinic and owner home ZIP codes to county-level 2019 Multidimensional Deprivation Index (MDI) values.

- Clinic ZIP is the first five digits of `vet_address.csv::postal_code`. This explicitly handles ZIP+4 values.
- Owner ZIP is the most frequently recorded `house_details.csv::primary_zip_code` for each dog. On ties, the first observed ZIP is retained to preserve the established analysis definition.
- MDI quintiles are calculated across all counties in `MDI_2019.csv` before being applied to clinic and owner counties.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source(here::here("R", "deprivation.R"))

# GRLS veterinary-clinic addresses
clinics <- read.csv(here::here("Data", "vet_address.csv"))

# Annual owner-reported home information, used to obtain the modal primary ZIP
owner_addresses <- read.csv(here::here("Data", "house_details.csv"))

# SimpleMaps ZIP-to-FIPS database
zip_lookup <- read.csv(here::here("Data", "uszips.csv"))

# County-level 2019 MDI data. The source CSV contains a UTF-8 byte-order mark.
mdi <- read.csv(
  here::here("Data", "MDI_2019.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
)

# Calculate MDI quintiles across all counties, link clinic ZIP to clinic MDI,
# calculate the modal owner home ZIP, and link it to owner MDI.
deprivation <- build_deprivation_dataset(
  clinics,
  owner_addresses,
  zip_lookup,
  mdi
)

# One row per GRLS dog with both clinic and owner deprivation measures
write.csv(
  deprivation,
  here::here("Output", "GRLS_dogs_MDI_2019.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
